Meta.title: 3YESES
Meta.description: 3YESES is a subscription-based talent marketplace connecting performers with projects and industry opportunities.

hero.title: Every talent deserves
hero.description: 3YESES started with a simple idea: talented people everywhere should have the chance to be seen. Not just the ones with connections or big-city access — {everyone}. From diverse communities around the world, we're building a place where creatives can showcase their work, build a name for themselves, and get discovered on their own terms.

origin.title: Why we built this
origin.p1: The creative industry has always had a visibility problem. Talented actors, musicians, models, dancers, voice artists, photographers, and performers of all kinds exist in every corner of the world — but most never get the chance to be seen beyond their local community.
origin.p2start: We wanted to change that. 3YESES was born from the belief that
origin.p2end: . Whether you're a street dancer in Accra, a classical violinist in Mumbai, a voice artist in Manchester, or a model in Buenos Aires — you deserve a professional platform to showcase your work and get noticed.
origin.p3: We built 3YESES to be radically simple and affordable. No gatekeeping, no approval process to join, no per-booking fees. One subscription gives you everything: unlimited uploads, a full professional profile, analytics to track your growth, and priority search placement so you actually get discovered.
origin.p4: This is your stage. Make it count.

values.title: What we stand for
values.subtitle: The principles that guide everything we build.
values.openDesc: No gatekeeping. No auditions to join. If you have talent, you belong here — regardless of where you come from, your background, or how much experience you have.
values.diversityDesc: We celebrate every genre, style, and culture. From classical musicians in Tokyo to street dancers in Lagos to voice artists in São Paulo — every creative deserves a stage.
values.communityDesc: Browse, like, comment, and share. Our hub brings performances and portfolios together so creatives can inspire each other and build real connections.
values.fairDesc: One simple subscription — £10 for 6 months or £20 for 12 months. No commissions, no hidden fees, no premium tiers. Everyone gets the same full access.

overview.title: Overview
overview.p1: These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the 3YESES platform ("Platform", "we", "us", "our"), a subscription-based talent marketplace operated at 3yeses.online. By creating an account or using any part of the Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms.
overview.p2: 3YESES is a platform where creative professionals — actors, musicians, models, dancers, voice artists, photographers, videographers, DJs, presenters, comedians, and other performers — create profiles, upload portfolio media (photos, videos, audio), and get discovered. The Platform includes a searchable talent directory, a media hub, analytics dashboards, and community features such as comments, likes, and content sharing.

privacy.introP1: This Privacy Policy explains how 3YESES ("Platform", "we", "us", "our") collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal data when you use our subscription-based talent marketplace at 3yeses.online.
privacy.introP2: We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal data in compliance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), the Data Protection Act 2018, and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

faqItems.q: How do I create an account on 3YESES?
faqItems.a: Click "Sign Up" and follow the 3-step process: enter your email and password, confirm your age (users under 13 need a parent-managed account; 13–17 need parental consent), then choose your subscription plan (6 or 12 months) and complete Stripe checkout. Your account activates instantly.

faqItems.q: What can I add to my profile?
faqItems.a: Your profile includes a bio, headshot, primary talent category, physical characteristics (height, body type, eye colour, hair colour), work history, languages spoken, skills (up to 4 featured), social media links, location, and optional fields like disabilities for inclusive casting.

faqItems.q: I forgot my password — how do I reset it?
faqItems.a: Go to the login page and click "Forgot password". Enter your registered email and we'll send a one-time reset link valid for 1 hour.
An active subscription is required. Choose between £10 for 6 months or £20 for 12 months. Both plans include identical features. No hidden fees.
Yes — cancel any time from Dashboard → Subscription. You keep full access until the end of your billing period.

faqItems.q: How do I upload portfolio items?
faqItems.a: Go to Dashboard → Portfolio and click "Add Item". The upload wizard walks you through 4 steps. Files can be up to 50 MB. For videos, you can pick a custom thumbnail.

faqItems.q: How do people view my portfolio?
faqItems.a: Visitors see your portfolio in a gallery grid on your profile. Clicking an item opens the media overlay with keyboard navigation.
Visitors browse the talent directory or Media Hub with advanced filters: gender, body type, ethnicity, age range, height range, skills, languages, disabilities, and location.
The Hub is a browsable feed of all portfolio content across the platform. You can filter by talent category, media type, and sort by trending, newest, or most viewed.
Your Dashboard shows profile views, unique viewers, portfolio views, likes received, search impressions, search clicks, CTR, and engagement rate.

faqItems.q: Can I interact with other users?
faqItems.a: Yes — you can comment on portfolio items, reply to comments, @mention other users, like portfolio items, and share profiles.

faqItems.q: How do I submit a support ticket?
faqItems.a: Go to the Submit a Ticket page from the Help Centre. Choose a category, provide a subject and description. You must be logged in.

faqItems.q: How long does it take to get a response?
faqItems.a: Support tickets are answered within 48 hours.
